findings.desc: dangling-cross-ref: §2.2 referenced but does not exist — §1.2 (line 17) and §1.3 (line 23) both cite §2.2 for the independence-test definition, but Section 2 has no numbered subsection 2.2; the independence test is defined under the unnumbered Step 2 heading. Reader directed to a non-existent anchor.

quality-cleanup: docs/parallel-decomposition-spec.md §4.4 — evaluateDecompositionGate(story, peers, contracts, cfg) has no TypeScript types for `peers` or `contracts` parameters; an implementer reading the spec cannot write a type-safe call from canStartDevGuard. `peers` must be StoryInfo[] filtered from store; `contracts` must be Map<string,ScopeContractData|null> or similar — neither is stated. This gap forces guesswork or `as any` at the call site.
